decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a publicly rebranded upgrade of a well-established trommel screen, so the investment and visible commitment remain high, and its absence from the website in 2020-2021 more plausibly reflects website changes than failure.
The multi-model flail shredder line had its own page and fits the mobile processing core, so sunk costs and public commitment favour persisting despite missing recent web evidence.

The high-speed grinder line had low visibility and has not been observed since, which raises the risk of dropping it, but as a multi-model line central to the mobile strategy, weak results can still be blamed on market conditions.
The green-waste grinder line serves core composting and biomass customers, so management would justify continuing it even with limited web presence.
The stationary pre-shredder line is visibly committed and central to the announced push into tougher stationary recycling solutions, so management is likely to persist with it.
